mapper.select: SELECT user_id, height, weight, birthday, gender, active_level, created_at, updated_at FROM users_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAt}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users_profile (user_id, height, weight, birthday, gender, active_level, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{birthday}, #{gender}, #{activeLevel}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET height = EXCLUDED.height, weight = EXCLUDED.weight, birthday = EXCLUDED.birthday, gender = EXCLUDED.gender, active_level = EXCLUDED.active_level, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
